bead.title: Ratify provider utilization and VCR specs
bead.description: Update and verify the provider design documents for first-class vLLM and llama-server utilization support and real-server cassette acceptance. In-scope files: docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-003-providers.md, docs/helix/02-design/solution-designs/SD-005-provider-config.md, and CONTRACT-003 if provider info or model info public fields change. Required behavior: type: llama-server is first-class; vLLM probes root /metrics; llama-server probes root /metrics when --metrics is enabled and falls back to /slots; go-vcr cassettes are recorded from real bootstrapped servers; ordinary tests replay cassettes. Out of scope: implementing providers, installing servers, or adding cassettes.
bead.acceptance: 1. rg -n 'llama-server|Provider Utilization Discovery|Real-Server Provider Cassettes|go-vcr' docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-003-providers.md succeeds. 2. rg -n 'D12A|D12B|D17|type: llama-server|type: vllm' docs/helix/02-design/solution-designs/SD-005-provider-config.md succeeds. 3. rg -n 'AC-FEAT-003-12|AC-FEAT-003-13|AC-FEAT-003-14' docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-003-providers.md succeeds. 4. ddx doc stale exits successfully or reports no stale provider docs caused by this change.
